source: a third-person explorer where you roam a small 3D world and collect gems, playable on mobile and desktop. On mobile use an on-screen virtual thumbstick anchored bottom-left to move the character; the thumbstick should also respond to mouse drag on desktop. DO NOT ASK ANY QUESTIONS JUST COMPLETE

answers.ask: No visual style was given - should the world be bright and stylized, or naturalistic? (The prompt asked not to be asked, so a neutral dressing is being used.)
answers.answer: Use a bright, stylized look appropriate for a simple collectible explorer game.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] theme — Q: No visual style was given - should the world be bright and stylized, or naturalistic? (The prompt asked not to be asked, so a neutral dressing is being used.) A: Use a bright, stylized look appropriate for a simple collectible explorer game.
- [agent_inferred] boundary — Q: How should the small world end? A: Use one compact, visibly bounded exterior area with mostly open navigable ground.

## Enriched image prompt
Create one small, bright, stylized 3D world with open connected ground that a third-person character can freely roam. Keep the compact exterior boundary and all navigable areas readable, leaving clear ground throughout for later gem placement without inventing a specific biome or landmark.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Adventure because free exploration is organized around collecting gems.

## Shape and preset
Use `world-open`, because the small world is one contiguous map explored in any order. The matched preset is Scavenger Hunt, keeping its open shape and requested `collectible-nodes` while omitting unrequested clue alcoves and a quest board.

## Config requirements
Reach outside Adventure's shortlist to No Genre's `boundary-edge`, drawing a subtle stylized terrain edge around the compact exterior without inventing a biome. The image otherwise supplies simple bright open navigable ground; gems remain a layout placement rather than being baked into the render.

## Layout requirements
Place `collectible-nodes` as gem pickups distributed across all reachable parts of the small world, with no fixed count because the author supplied none. Place one player arrival on clear ground with more than one direction available. Mobile controls, mouse drag, and on-screen thumbsticks are not layout placements.

## Layout components
The build is one compact exterior zone with connected open terrain, one player arrival, a visible outer boundary, and reachable gem positions spread across the navigable surface. No buildings, separate maps, water, vertical stack, or biome-specific props are inferred. Compose the full small world in one frame.

## Render order
Use `isometric`: the simple bright world composition is authoritative, and no exact topology beyond one connected surface is required.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The scale band is small, directly following the author's request for a small world. The theme is bright and stylized. `P0` is sufficient because the map is one grounded exterior surface with no overhangs, interiors, or separate zones.
